meta.title: Reguły weryfikacji greenwashingu
meta.source_list: Przepisy.docx + ISAP PDFs + ECGT FAQ 2026 + CPC old stock + Sejm 2799/3043 + Senat 825 + UOKiK 2025-2026 + UCPD Guidance 2021 + LEED v4.1 BD+C

pl_transposition.note: Not published in Dz.U.; ECGT still applies from 2026-09-27

immediate_reject.message: Znak zrównoważoności bez systemu certyfikacji ani organu publicznego.

immediate_reject.unless: EU Ecolabel or recognised ISO 14024 Type I relevant to the claim, specified in the same medium
immediate_reject.visuals: leaf, water drop, green wash, planet may be an implicit claim or a sustainability label

examples: zeroemisyjna firma przy jednym magazynie PV
zielona dostawa przy EV tylko na last mile
zero waste we własnych obiektach przy 1 z 40 sklepów

immediate_reject.message: Zakaz bez wyjątków: offset nie uzasadnia claimu GHG o produkcie.

examples: zgodny z obowiązującym prawem jako benefit

always_on_tests.test: 100% renewable via EAC/GO without explanation is likely misleading (UOKiK Bolt)

fmcg.requires: Regulation 2018/848 certification; processed food generally >=95% organic agricultural ingredients for sales description; lex specialis vs ECGT 4a on food
authorised control body certificate under Dz.U. 2022 poz. 1370

fmcg.prohibits: attributing properties the food does not have; presenting common features as special

finance.do_not: market art.8 as sustainable-objective art.9 product

finance.plus: Paris-aligned benchmark exclusions depending on term

finance.use: alignment not mere eligibility; include DNSH

transport.require: denominator in vehicle-km or tkm not a photo of one EV

textiles.reject_if: sustainable collection claim based on small recycled share

textiles.require: advertising consistent with digital product passport data

textiles.note: after Omnibus I: apply from 2029 for very large companies; SMEs indirectly via chain

textiles.reject_if: Join Life / net-zero / zero-waste headline without store-level or product-level scope

construction.zero_emission_building: no on-site fossil CO2; energy demand threshold >=10% below nZEB threshold of 2024-05-28

construction.forbid: BREEAM/LEED/material EPD used as proof the whole investment is zero-emission

construction.require: same product variant and LCA modules as claimed

construction.note: NC v7.1 is default registration; technical manual is login-only; whole-life carbon is a scheme aim not an EPBD status
public rating system PDF July 2020 is a credit catalogue, not EPBD art. 11

enforcement_pl.uokik_max_fine: 10% turnover per practice, even unintentional (art. 106 + art. 24)
